asA: chain author running a one-off flag sweep on a downstream product
iWant: one command that lists every live criterion without a flag, with its story and spec
soThat: the sweep reads the chain only and ends when the count reaches zero
description: rcf define validate --report verification as the sweep worklist.
title: A chain author on a downstream product runs the flag sweep from validate's worklist

acceptanceCriteria.description: [happy] Given a fixture project with 3 live criteria, 1 flagged and 2 unflagged, and FBS-001 scoping the first unflagged criterion, when rcf define validate --report verification runs, then it exits 0 and stdout holds two worklist lines "<AC id>\t<US id>\t<FBS id or ->\t<first 80 characters of the description>" in id order (FBS-001 on the scoped one, - on the other) followed by "verification: 2 of 3 live criteria unflagged".

[edge] Given every live criterion flagged, rcf define validate --report verification exits 0 and prints only "verification: 0 of <n> live criteria unflagged"; with --json it prints {"unflagged": [], "live": <n>}, and with unflagged criteria each entry is { acId, usId, fbsId (string or null), description }.

[non-functional] Given a fixture chain of 1000 live criteria across 250 stories with none flagged (the heavy sweep), when rcf define validate --report verification runs, then it finishes within 1.5 times a plain rcf define validate over the same tree and prints exactly 1001 lines, because the worklist reuses the validate walk.

[failure] Given --report naming anything other than verification (for example --report flags), rcf define validate exits 2 with stderr "[error] usage --report takes verification" and prints no worklist line.

[must-not] The worklist never writes: after rcf define validate --report verification, every file under rcf/ is byte-identical and git status --porcelain is unchanged, and the worklist never assigns or suggests a flag for any criterion.
